experience.summary: Designed and delivered IT training sessions covering programming, cybersecurity, and related domains. Prepared course materials and guided participants through hands-on labs.

Owned the quality of the LojaMi application across SIT, UAT, and Trial Operation phases. Performed functional, exploratory, regression, and bug-fix retesting; surfaced critical defects affecting the main business flow before go-live.

Identified vulnerabilities in IT infrastructure and web applications via simulated real-world attacks; delivered VAPT reports for clients across multiple industries. Handled incident response (e.g., web defacement), led Sawah Cyber Security CTF 2025 as technical team and cryptography problem setter, organized ethical-hacking masterclasses, and built Cypress automation for the company website.

experience.company: PT Clean Medic Indus — B3 medical-waste app
experience.summary: Owned full QA campaigns across web portal and mobile (Android / iOS) for the CLEAN MEDIC platform managing B3 medical-waste workflows. Designed test plans, automation scripts (Selenium / Cypress / Postman), regression cycles, and quality metrics — achieving >90% functionality test coverage.
Analyzed product requirements, planned test strategies and test cases, and developed automation testing code to improve usability across Traveloka's travel-platform features.

Developed test strategies, plans, and cases. Maintained QA processes and collaborated within cross-functional, international Agile teams — testing, debugging, retesting, and validating software readiness for shipping.
Selected as a Junior Tester via Mitrais' bootcamp QA Tester program; foundational training in test strategies, automation, and Agile collaboration.
Built a PHP web app using the CodeIgniter framework — a hotel reservation system for both public users and internal management staff.
